title: dryopteris ridleyana
intro: Dryopteris ridleyana, commonly known as the Ridley's shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of cardiovascular health, and the enhancement of immune function. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris ridleyana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its ability to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
